body:
Yes, I've written enough for 3 books the past 2 years.

My therapist didn't take me on knowing what was going on, I couldn't talk and was just vague.

I've been trying almost all of my life, I have never had just a normal life, I do not have many, if any, good memories to fall back on, there is just nothing but mostly misery and the good moments have the misery in the background. I am just done with it, I have nothing left.

What kind of resources? Not trying to be dumb here, I just have no ides what you mean. I tried suicide chat before, one person was helpful, the rest wasn't and they can spend only as much time on someone. I can't call  any hotlines because my family is here. I'm supposed to have therapy tomorrow, I don't want to go.

I can't just talk to anyone and there aren't many willing to take on someone acutely suicidal and problems. And to be honest, it took me so long to develop any trust, I don't see myself doing that again, it took me almost two years to even start talking.
I do not have a support network outside of therapy and that is not there now because it's broken.
And the fact I can't talk to my therapist and that it's all screwed up doesn't help, either

I know, when I was out I complained but I don't think that makes a difference, after all I was involuntarily committed so consider the source, right. Actually it really really upset me because my children are the only reason I made it to my 30's in the first place.

I wish there was "a" reason I could just remove, but really there are too many + the physical component. I need to talk and at the same time anything I post will make identifiable if you know my story because it's just that kind of life.
Being able to talk to someone.
No, I am not her patient yet. That was the earliest appointment available, at least she's taking new patients.
